reason: Accepted E7/E8 package excludes Sea naming because identity and split/merge contract are unresolved. Owner requested names of all nameable map elements; analyst work is explicitly required by the current E8 spec. Waiting for PR490 release does not block this bounded analysis.
scope: Inventory actual Sea connected-component/identity/name behavior at accepted SHA and current water E6 contract.
Specify stable Sea identity and deterministic name preservation on unchanged/expanded/split/merged seas; clearly expose authored-name conflicts and safe refusal.
Specify old v2-v8 migration, persisted names/IDs, import validation, undo/redo, continuation and dependencies with water operations.
Reuse bilingual name editor and existing water/transaction validation; propose compact desktop/narrow states based on current interface and show them without waiting for a third approval.
Trace criterion_id and before/expected/delta as unknown where not supported; no score award.
out_of_scope: Change or release of accepted PR490 package
expected_output: Bounded developer-ready E8-N-SEA spec + deterministic split/merge examples and AC + UI preview desktop/narrow + handoff identifying whether any substantial scope expansion remains.
completion_gate: No name bound to an arbitrary hex as sea identity.
Every split/merge/name conflict has one explicit deterministic outcome or atomic refusal.
Exact accepted-SHA inspection and migration/error/history acceptance cases recorded.
Show actual proposed UI and preserve unresolved choices; substantial expansion referred to owner.
stop_conditions: Conflicting foreign claim on this stage
Substantial expansion outside the existing all-map-names task

feedback_disposition.action: Reuse existing audit evidence and require useful nonduplicating tests; no repeat full audit during name specification.
Respect requested EN startup and compact panel; do not treat pending PR491 as published baseline or broaden its publication permission.

next_step: Подготовить E8-N-SEA: устойчивый ID моря, сохранение и конфликт имён при split/merge, миграция/Undo/Redo, компактный desktop/narrow UI и проверяемая спецификация; показать предложение без ожидания третьего согласования.

user_effect.before: У моря нет утверждённого контракта стабильной идентичности и имени при изменении воды.
user_effect.after: Мастер сможет назвать море и сохранить имя после расширения, загрузки и отмены; разделение и слияние имеют явный безопасный исход.
user_effect.example: «Северное море» после добавления соседних водных гексов остаётся тем же именованным объектом; при объединении с «Заливом Туманов» авторские имена не теряются молча.
